intro: Unwind in style with the Waltz bar cabinet. With storage for bottles, glasses, and accessories, its Antiq finish and compact design make every pour feel like an occasion worth celebrating.

features.title: Organized storage space
features.text: Dedicated spaces for horizontal bottles, inverted glasses, and accessories keep your bar setup neat and ready.

features.title: Compact yet storage-rich design
features.text: Holds wine, beer, and liquor essentials while saving space, making it perfect for apartments or modern dining rooms.

features.title: Strong Sheesham wood structure
features.text: Crafted from Dura Wood (Sheesham), the cabinet promises strength, durability, and long life with natural beauty.

features.title: Clean look with hidden utility
features.text: Dual-door design gives a tidy, elegant exterior while keeping bar essentials concealed yet easily accessible.

features.title: Antiq Walnut finish with warmth
features.text: The deep walnut tone adds sophistication, blending seamlessly with contemporary or classic interiors.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Waltz Bar Cabinet
